name_en: Compactness preservation under closed subsets and continuous images
canonical_name: Two preservation properties of compact sets in general topological spaces
literal_source_claim_zh: 紧集的闭子集紧，连续像紧
literal_source_claim_en: Closed subsets of compact sets are compact, and continuous images of compact sets are compact.
canonical_statement: Closed subsets of compact sets are compact, and continuous images of compact sets are compact.
canonical_claim: The catalog root contains both independent preservation clauses: a closed subset of a compact set is compact, and the image of a compact set under a continuous map is compact. Exact definitions, assumptions, binder scopes, encodings, and root composition remain for source review and the Lean statement gate.
